convert_caffe_model_to_detectron: run the script to convert a Caffe model prototxt and caffemodel into a Detectron pickle weights file
normalize_resnet_layer_names: run the normalize_resnet_name function to convert ResNet layer names like res4b11_branch2c to res4_11_branch2c
pickle_caffe_weights_to_file: run the pickle_weights function to save Caffe2 weight blobs as a pickled numpy dictionary to an output file
add_missing_conv_biases: run the add_missing_biases function to inject zero-initialized bias blobs into Caffe convolution layers that lack them
remove_spatial_batch_norm_layers: run the remove_spatial_bn_layers function to extract and fold BatchNorm and Scale layer parameters into Caffe2 SpatialBN tensors
